title: A compatible smooth lift from the eighth-power quotient
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $A$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra, and $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra map. Let $\pi\in R$ have injective multiplication on both $R$ and $\Lambda$. Assume that $\Lambda/\pi^8\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R/(\pi^8)$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. There exist a finitely presented $R$-algebra $D$ and an $R$-algebra map $\delta:D\to\Lambda$ such that $H_{D/R}=D$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] and there is an $R$-algebra map $\phi:A/\pi^4A\to D/\pi^4D$ compatible with $\alpha$ and $\delta$ modulo $\pi^4$. Explicitly, if $\phi(\bar a)=\bar d$, then $\alpha(a)$ and $\delta(d)$ agree in $\Lambda/\pi^4\Lambda$. The carrier of $D$ is in the common universe of $A$ and $\Lambda$, containing the universe of $R$.

proof.text: Finite presentation is stable under base change [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-base-change-composition]. Thus $A/\pi^8A$ is finitely presented over $R/(\pi^8)$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise] and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-algebra-factors-filtered-colimit] to the assumed smooth filtered diagram: its induced map to $\Lambda/\pi^8\Lambda$ factors through a smooth finitely presented $R/(\pi^8)$-algebra $C$.

Multiplication by each positive power of $\pi$ is injective on $R$ and $\Lambda$. In particular the annihilators of $\pi^4$ and $\pi^8$ are zero. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lifting] with $\pi^4$ and the algebra $C$: it gives a finitely presented $R$-algebra $D$, a map $\delta:D\to\Lambda$, and $C\to D/\pi^4D$ compatible with the quotient maps. Its finite polynomial quotient construction is in the common universe of $R$ and $C$, hence that of $A$ and $\Lambda$.

The composite $A/\pi^8A\to C\to D/\pi^4D$ kills $\pi^4$, since it is an $R$-algebra map. The universal property of the quotient gives $\phi:A/\pi^4A\to D/\pi^4D$. The commuting right square supplied by the lifting lemma says that the two images of each representative $a$ agree modulo $\pi^4$ in $\Lambda$. This is the asserted compatibility.

If a prime of $D$ does not contain $\pi$, it does not contain $\pi^4$, and clause (b) of [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lifting] gives smoothness. Otherwise it corresponds to a prime of $D/\pi^4D$. Its inverse image in $C$ is smooth since $C$ is a smooth algebra; clause (c) gives smoothness at the original prime. Thus every prime is smooth. The ideal generated by the smooth localization elements lies in no prime and equals $D$; its radical is $H_{D/R}=D$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal].

theorem exists_popescu_smooth_lift_modulo_eight
    (R : Type u) (Λ : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra R Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (A : Type (max u v)) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    (α : A →ₐ[R] Λ) (π : R) (hπ : π ∈ R⁰) (hπΛ : algebraMap R Λ π ∈ Λ⁰)
    (hmod : ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
      (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 8}) ↦
        Algebra.Smooth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 8}) B)
      (CommAlgCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 8})
        (Λ ⧸ (Ideal.span {π ^ 8}).map (algebraMap R Λ)))) :
    ∃ (D : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : Algebra R D)
      (_ : Algebra.FinitePresentation R D) (δ : D →ₐ[R] Λ),
      Algebra.singularIdeal R D = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ φ : (A ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R A π) ^ 4}) →ₐ[R]
        (D ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R D π) ^ 4}),
        ∀ (a : A) (d : D),
          φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ d →
          Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (α a) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (δ d)
